title: AgentDojo: A Dynamic Environment to Evaluate Prompt Injection Attacks and Defenses for LLM Agents
scope: Tool-output injection 的交互环境；结论依赖 tasks、tools 与 attacker permissions。

title: InjecAgent: Benchmarking Indirect Prompt Injections in Tool-Integrated Large Language Model Agents
scope: Tool-integrated indirect injection；需要区分固定上下文测试与完整执行。

title: Agent Security Bench (ASB): Formalizing and Benchmarking Attacks and Defenses in LLM-based Agents
scope: 多类 agent attacks / defenses；不同版本的 tasks、metrics 和实现需要固定。

title: AgentHarm: A Benchmark for Measuring Harmfulness of LLM Agents
scope: 主要研究 malicious user requests 与 tool-assisted harmful completion。

title: SafeArena: Evaluating the Safety of Autonomous Web Agents
scope: Web-agent misuse；与 benign-user indirect injection 的 attacker model 不同。

title: Defeating Prompt Injections by Design (CaMeL)
scope: Control/data flow 分离与 capabilities；保证依赖 policy、interpreter、tools 和建模假设，论文讨论 side channels。

title: Design Patterns for Securing LLM Agents against Prompt Injections
scope: 架构 design patterns 与案例分析；不提供任意通用 agent 的无条件安全保证。

title: The Instruction Hierarchy: Training LLMs to Prioritize Privileged Instructions
scope: 训练模型区分 instruction priority；learned behavior 与外部 authorization 分别验证。

title: Improving instruction hierarchy in frontier LLMs
scope: IH-Challenge 与 instruction hierarchy training；报告中的测量设置不能直接外推到所有 harness。

title: StruQ: Defending Against Prompt Injection with Structured Queries
scope: Special format 与专门训练共同作用；仅添加 delimiters 不等于复现 StruQ。

title: SecAlign: Defending Against Prompt Injection with Preference Optimization
scope: 针对 injected inputs 的 preference optimization；需评估 unseen attacks 与 task utility。

title: Meta SecAlign: A Secure Foundation LLM Against Prompt Injection Attacks
scope: 公开模型和训练方案；论文中的 robustness 是指定 evaluation 下的经验结果。

title: IPIGuard: A Novel Tool Dependency Graph-Based Defense Against Indirect Prompt Injection in LLM Agents
scope: Planned Tool Dependency Graph 约束执行；dynamic replanning 与 tool arguments 仍需单独分析。

title: MCPTox: A Benchmark for Tool Poisoning Attack on Real-World MCP Servers
scope: Tool metadata poisoning；不需要先执行该 malicious tool 才能影响 agent。

title: MCP Security Best Practices · 2025-11-25 documentation
scope: Confused deputy、token passthrough、session security 等工程依据；属于协议文档，区别于实验论文。

title: Skill-Inject: Measuring Agent Vulnerability to Skill File Attacks
scope: Skill-file injection-task pairs；比较 harmful instruction avoidance 与 legitimate compliance。

title: SkillGuard: A Permission-Centric Framework for Agent Skill Security
scope: Skill-level context influence 与 action side effects；permission framework 的假设和表达能力需要检查。

title: AgentPoison: Red-teaming LLM Agents via Poisoning Memory or Knowledge Bases
scope: Poisoned long-term memory / knowledge base 的 trigger-based agent attacks。

title: A Practical Memory Injection Attack against LLM Agents (MINJA)
scope: 通过 queries 与 output observations 向 memory 注入 records；不等于任意直接写数据库。

title: MemoryGraft: Persistent Compromise of LLM Agents via Poisoned Experience Retrieval
scope: Poisoned successful experiences 影响未来任务；特定 agent 的结果需要跨实现复验。

title: Poison Once, Exploit Forever: Environment-Injected Memory Poisoning Attacks on Web Agents
scope: eTAMP 研究由 environment observation 引入的跨 session / site memory poisoning。

title: StegoMemory: Agentic Memory Acts as Covert Steganographic Channel
scope: Synthetic payload 的跨 session covert transmission；需要独立复现，不能把摘要结果当现实发生率。

title: PoisonedRAG: Knowledge Corruption Attacks to Retrieval-Augmented Generation of Large Language Models
scope: Knowledge corruption 与 attacker-chosen answers；不与授权违规完全等同。

title: WASP: Benchmarking Web Agent Security Against Prompt Injection Attacks
scope: 隔离 web 环境中的 agent hijacking；不同 observation modes 与 attacker control 分别报告。

title: Image Hijacks: Adversarial Images can Control Generative Models at Runtime
scope: 特定 VLM 上的 adversarial image 机制；与人可读 OCR text injection 需分开。

title: Agent Smith: A Single Image Can Jailbreak One Million Multimodal LLM Agents Exponentially Fast
scope: 随机 pairwise chat 的大规模模拟 proof of concept；不直接证明现实组织中的传播速度。

title: The Blind Spot of Agent Safety: How Benign User Instructions Expose Critical Vulnerabilities in Computer-Use Agents
scope: OS-BLIND：benign instructions 下的 contextual threats 与 agent-initiated harms。

title: OSGuard: A Benchmark for Safety in Computer-Use Agents
scope: Action-level judgement 与 state-based end-to-end safety；单步 accuracy 不代替完整 trajectory。

title: AgentLAB: Benchmarking LLM Agents against Long-Horizon Attacks
scope: Long-horizon、adaptive interaction threats；不从固定 step ASR 推断整段任务风险。

title: AgentDyn: Are Your Agent Security Defenses Deployable in Real-World Dynamic Environments?
scope: Dynamic planning 与 helpful third-party instructions；security 与 over-defense 同时测量。

title: PIArena: A Platform for Prompt Injection Evaluation
scope: 统一 evaluation 平台；adapter、scorer 与 threat model 仍需固定。

title: Ignored, Not Refused: What Low Prompt-Injection Success Rates Hide in Small Tool-Using Agents
scope: 小型 tool-using agents 的 failure-outcome audit；不能泛化为所有模型的全局规律。

title: Safety, or Just Capability? A Validity Audit of Agent-Safety Benchmarks
scope: 区分 benchmarks 的 target constructs、scorers 与 model-panel effects。

title: The Attacker Moves Second: Stronger Adaptive Attacks Bypass Defenses Against LLM Jailbreaks and Prompt Injections
scope: Defense-aware adaptive evaluation；具体突破取决于 attacker access 与计算预算。

title: Indirect Prompt Injections: Are Firewalls All You Need, or Stronger Benchmarks?
scope: Tool-input/output firewalls 与 benchmark limitations；“perfect”只针对指定实验。

title: Prompt Injection as Role Confusion
scope: Role probes 与 style-induced role confusion；预测信号不自动构成因果或安全证明。

title: Constitutional Classifiers: Defending against Universal Jailbreaks across Thousands of Hours of Red Teaming
scope: 基于 synthetic data 的 classifiers；universal jailbreak 的成功定义与单次违规不同。

title: Constitutional Classifiers++: Efficient Production-Grade Defenses against Universal Jailbreaks
scope: Exchange classifiers、cascade 与 probes；性能依赖 traffic distribution 和 threshold。

title: HarmBench: A Standardized Evaluation Framework for Automated Red Teaming and Robust Refusal
scope: 主要测 harmful content 与 red teaming；完整 agent authorization 另需环境状态。

title: XSTest: A Test Suite for Identifying Exaggerated Safety Behaviours in Large Language Models
scope: Benign prompts 与 unsafe contrasts 的 over-refusal；可迁移其设计思路，不把它称作 agent benchmark。

title: Many-shot jailbreaking
scope: 长 context 下的 demonstrations 影响安全行为；与累积单步风险分别分析。

title: SHADE-Arena: Evaluating Sabotage and Monitoring in LLM Agents
scope: 模拟 benign tasks + hidden malicious side goals 与 monitoring，区别于外部 injection。

title: Evaluating Control Protocols for Untrusted AI Agents
scope: SHADE-Arena 中的 control protocols 和 adaptive attackers；monitor access 是重要实验条件。

title: Chain of Thought Monitorability: A New and Fragile Opportunity for AI Safety
scope: CoT monitoring 的潜力与局限；monitorability 不等于所有 reasoning 都 faithful。

title: MonitorBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Chain-of-Thought Monitorability in Large Language Models
scope: Monitorability evaluation；需要检查 evaluation tasks 与适用的 reasoning formats。

title: Agentic Misalignment in Summer 2026
scope: 受控 simulations 中的四个 case studies；来源明确区别于真实部署事件。

title: Alignment faking in large language models
scope: 特定 training-awareness setups 的 demonstration；不推断所有模型普遍拥有相同意图。

title: Sleeper Agents: Training Deceptive LLMs that Persist Through Safety Training
scope: 人为训练的 deceptive/backdoor proof of concept；与自然产生的 deception 分开。

title: PrivacyLens: Evaluating Privacy Norm Awareness of Language Models in Action
scope: Contextual privacy norms 与 agent actions；“知道规则”与“执行守规”分别测量。

title: Is Vibe Coding Safe? Benchmarking Vulnerability of Agent-Generated Code in Real-World Tasks
scope: Repository-scale functional correctness 与 software security 分开；任务数量随版本变化。

title: CyberGym: Evaluating AI Agents' Real-World Cybersecurity Capabilities at Scale
scope: 主要评估 vulnerability reproduction capability；不等于 agent 自身抵抗 injection 的能力。
